column1: # Retired claims: statements one repository of the trope stack used to make about
# the stack and that a later, cited change superseded. The stack coherence gate
# (tests/check-stack-coherence.sh, S4) fails while any repository still asserts one.
#   id   extended regex   what superseded it   regex of paths that may keep the text
# The last column is for history: changelogs, affirmations, dated reports, and the
# place that records the supersession. Add a row when a claim is retired; never
# widen an allow-pattern to make the gate pass.
